_note:
The Svelte compiler gives every block fragment ({#if} branches, {#each} fallback, {#await} bodies, {#key}, snippet bodies), every element and every named-slot child its own scope, declares {@const} into the innermost one, resolves {#each}/{:then}/snippet pattern defaults inside the block's scope, visits the {:else} fallback of {#each} inside the each scope, and declares a snippet's name in the enclosing scope. A {@const title} inside {#if} therefore no longer hides the script's `title` from a later

{title}

(Legacy2: no export_let_unused), a template read that sits beside a same-named {@const} still counts (IfConst/Sibling: non_reactive_update), each-context and snippet names shadow script bindings (Fallback/Default/Snip: nothing), and a slot="…" child does not see the component's default let: bindings (NamedSlot: non_reactive_update). Verified against svelte-check 4.4.6 / svelte 5.55.
